title: Tunisia, country of broken dreams: 'I wanted to photograph the young people whose lives began with the revolution'
subhed: 'Growing up in hostile environments' (3/7). Tunisian photographer Zied Ben Romdhane has documented his country since the fall of Ben Ali and the Arab Spring in late 2010. His work captures the deep malaise of a generation that has known only political turmoil and a lack of economic opportunities. Deprived of hope, on the edge of a sun-drenched sea, these young people dream solely of leaving.

title: 'Why shouldn't I have the right to do what Angelina Jolie did?': Inside a breast surgery clinic in Paris
